what: The 42 canonical P1-27 tasks, one row each, with the universe derived from canonical-plan.md.
whyDerived: This phase once counted 33 adjudicated items as 42 canonical tasks. Nine were listed nowhere. The universe is read from the plan so a task cannot be forgotten.
verdictsAreJudged: Every evidence field and FINAL_VERDICT comes from docs/phase-1/phase-1-27/task-matrix-verdicts.json, which is hand-written and reviewable. Only the universe is generated.
